lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、日本列島の地殻構造を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper was about the crustal structure of the Japanese archipelago, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm but precise. Gently checking in. Soft opening, steady pace. Teacher's attentiveness — she's been reading the work carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、感覚と知覚の違いを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the distinction between sensation and perception.
lines.style: Polite, slightly surprised at the disconnect. Quick, straightforward. Respectful correction without defensiveness. Eyes steady on the teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 垂直農法を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered vertical farming, I recall.
lines.style: Thoughtful restatement. Pauses slightly before speaking. Gentle, not pressuring. The tone of someone reviewing their notes and confirming they're listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、特異点の数学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I explored the mathematics of singularities in that one.
lines.style: Quiet precision. Slight emphasis on the correction. Not apologetic — just accurate. Brief and clear, like she's helpfully pointing out where the record was off.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 規制が消費者に与える不利益を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your paper examined the disadvantages regulations create for consumers?
lines.style: Following thread carefully. Warm, genuinely curious about whether she's got this right. Leans forward slightly. Inviting confirmation or gentle correction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、神経中枢の機能を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, that one was about the functions of the nervous system's central structures.
lines.style: Calm correction. Not frustrated — just matter-of-fact. Respectful but clear. She's used to being the one who knows what she actually wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 技術進歩の著しい分野を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Fields with rapid technological progress — you covered one of those?
lines.style: Gentle summary attempt. A little uncertain now. Kind teacher voice, genuinely trying to follow. Slight lift at the end — open to being corrected again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、グラフ理論のノード構造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on node structures in graph theory.
lines.style: Settled, confident now. Direct eye contact. Brief, complete answer. She knows her work. No unnecessary words.
